## Researchable Equipment Integra - Integra helmet. Protects against the memetic and cognitive effects of SCP-035, SCP-012, and SCP-247
Bridle - Bridle of Silence. Fitted onto SCP-939 to force it into pacifism
Locus - Locus vest. Prevents SCP-106 from taking the wearer into the pocket dimension, though the player still takes damage
Mimicry - Mimicry boots. Allow the wearer to remain unnoticed by SCP-939
Aegis - Aegis implanter. Implanted under the skin to prevent SCP-049 from turning the wearer into SCP-049-2, but does NOT protect against its touch
Obscura - Obscura helmet. Hides SCP-096's face, keeping anyone who looks at it unharmed
Pandora - "Pandora" hangar. Used to transport SCP-173
Stasis - Stasis drops. Prevent blinking for a set amount of time
